cases.title: From the essay: features ship dark
cases.question: In Brad’s essay, how do new features reach customers?
cases.answer: New features reach customers in steps, and most of them start turned off. Most new features reach production turned off, so merging and deploying code doesn't change what customers see. Turning it on is a separate, deliberate step that takes effect in seconds and can be undone the same way. The essay describes a four-step path: Merged dark. The code ships behind a gate that is off for everyone. Next, on for Brad's account. Brad switches it on for Brad's own account in production through a per-user override. Then on for everyone. One command through the production-task CLI turns the gate on, for example `prod-task shop-ai:on`. Finally, kept with a kill switch. Every live feature keeps a named off switch, such as `prod-task shop-ai:off`, and AGENTS.md lists it beside the feature.
